description: Capture, review and package reproducible scene-feature figures
commands: uv run physicalview run paper --action capture --config configs/local.yaml --scene room_factory --out outputs/paper/room
uv run physicalview run paper --action pack --root outputs/paper
uv run physicalview run paper --action zip --root outputs/paper --out outputs/downloads
inputs: Constructed scenes; campaign root for multi-scene reports
outputs: 14 feature groups per scene, sidecar hashes, panels and downloadable review packs. Captured, complete and publication-approved are separate states.
